knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,

## 分析目的

比較**同一現象**（家庭看護工行蹤不明）在兩個視角下的歸因差異：

- **移工自述（103年）**：移工問卷 v13，「您知不知道造成您同鄉行蹤不明的原因？」（家庭類 N=1,958 知道原因者）
- **雇主認知（113年）**：家庭面問卷 q5a，「您認為看護工失聯/逃跑的原因為何？」（N=146 曾有失聯者）

若兩者對同一原因的比例差距愈大，代表雙方對失聯成因的認知存在明顯落差。

---

## 資料說明

| 題目 | 資料集 | 受訪者 | 分母 |
|------|--------|--------|------|
| `v13_1`–`v13_12` | `data103_2.csv`（家庭類） | 移工本人 | 知道原因者（v13==1），N≈1,958 |
| `q5a_1`–`q5a_9` | `data113.csv`（家庭面） | 雇主 | 曾發生失聯者（q5==2），N=146 |

> **注意**：103 年編碼方式為「選項編號 / 0」（有選=選項號碼，未選=0），113 年為「1/0」二元碼。

---

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(showtext)
library(Hmisc)
library(ggtext)

font_add_google("Noto Sans TC", "NotoSans")
showtext_auto()
```

```{r load-103}
base_dir <- if (basename(getwd()) == "reports") ".." else "."
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data")

# ── 103年：家庭類移工問卷 ─────────────────────────────────
d103 <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "103年針對移工問卷/data103_2.csv"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "big5"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(v13 == 1) %>%                       # 知道原因者
  mutate(w = as.numeric(w))

total_w103 <- sum(d103$w, na.rm = TRUE)

# 各原因：value != 0 表示勾選
reasons103 <- tribble(
  ~col,      ~label,
  "v13_1",   "聘僱期限\n即將屆滿",
  "v13_2",   "工作環境\n無法適應",
  "v13_3",   "與雇主/家人\n相處不融洽",
  "v13_4",   "思鄉情緒",
  "v13_5",   "仲介公司\n從中媒介",
  "v13_6",   "生活環境\n無法適應",
  "v13_7",   "希望獲得\n較高待遇",
  "v13_8",   "受他人\n慫恿/轉介",
  "v13_9",   "勞資爭議",
  "v13_10",  "仲介服務費\n太高",
  "v13_11",  "外籍配偶\n媒介"
) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = map_dbl(col, function(c) {
      vals <- as.numeric(d103[[c]])
      wt   <- d103$w
      weighted.mean(vals != 0, wt, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    perspective = "移工自述（103年）"
  )
```

```{r load-113}
# ── 113年：家庭面雇主問卷 ─────────────────────────────────
d113 <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "113年移工/家庭面/data113.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(q5 == 2) %>%                        # 曾有失聯者
  mutate(w = as.numeric(w))

total_w113 <- sum(d113$w, na.rm = TRUE)

reasons113 <- tribble(
  ~col,      ~label,
  "q5a_1",   "受他人\n慫恿/轉介",
  "q5a_2",   "工作/生活環境\n無法適應",
  "q5a_3",   "工作條件不佳\n（薪資偏低）",
  "q5a_4",   "非法打工\n可賺更多",
  "q5a_5",   "個人\n自由意志",
  "q5a_6",   "工作時間\n無法負荷",
  "q5a_7",   "仲介服務費\n太高",
  "q5a_9",   "其他"
) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = map_dbl(col, function(c) {
      vals <- as.integer(d113[[c]] == 1)
      wt   <- d113$w
      weighted.mean(vals, wt, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    perspective = "雇主認知（113年）"
  )
```

```{r build-dumbbell}
# ── 對應分類（只保留兩份問卷都有的可比類別）─────────────
# 以 113年雇主問卷的類別為主軸，對應 103年最相近的選項

dumbbell <- tribble(
  ~category,              ~col103,    ~col113,
  "受他人慫恿/轉介",      "v13_8",    "q5a_1",
  "工作/生活環境不適應",  "v13_2",    "q5a_2",   # 103年用工作環境
  "希望較高待遇/薪資低",  "v13_7",    "q5a_3",
  "仲介費太高",           "v13_10",   "q5a_7",
  "工時無法負荷",         NA_character_, "q5a_6",
  "與雇主/家人不融洽",    "v13_3",    NA_character_,
  "勞資爭議",             "v13_9",    NA_character_
)

get_pct103 <- function(col) {
  if (is.na(col)) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- as.numeric(d103[[col]])
  weighted.mean(vals != 0, d103$w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

get_pct113 <- function(col) {
  if (is.na(col)) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- as.integer(d113[[col]] == 1)
  weighted.mean(vals, d113$w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

db <- dumbbell %>%
  mutate(
    pct103 = map_dbl(col103, get_pct103),
    pct113 = map_dbl(col113, get_pct113),
    # 排序：以兩者平均值排
    avg = rowMeans(cbind(pct103, pct113), na.rm = TRUE),
    category = fct_reorder(category, avg)
  )
```

## 圖1：啞鈴圖——同一原因，兩個視角的比例差距

```{r dumbbell-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.5}
col_worker   <- "#1F3145"  # 深藍：移工
col_employer <- "#DE4429"  # 橘紅：雇主

# 僅保留兩者皆有數值的類別（有 NA 的另外標注）
db_both <- db %>% filter(!is.na(pct103) & !is.na(pct113))
db_only103 <- db %>% filter(!is.na(pct103) & is.na(pct113))
db_only113 <- db %>% filter(is.na(pct103) & !is.na(pct113))

p_db <- ggplot(db_both, aes(y = category)) +
  # 連接線
  geom_segment(aes(x = pct103, xend = pct113, yend = category),
               color = "#cccccc", linewidth = 1.5) +
  # 移工點（深藍）
  geom_point(aes(x = pct103), color = col_worker,  size = 6) +
  # 雇主點（橘紅）
  geom_point(aes(x = pct113), color = col_employer, size = 6) +
  # 移工數值標注
  geom_text(aes(x = pct103,
                label = percent(pct103, 0.1),
                hjust = if_else(pct103 > pct113, -0.35, 1.35)),
            color = col_worker, size = 5.5, fontface = "bold",
            family = "NotoSans") +
  # 雇主數值標注
  geom_text(aes(x = pct113,
                label = percent(pct113, 0.1),
                hjust = if_else(pct113 > pct103, -0.35, 1.35)),
            color = col_employer, size = 5.5, fontface = "bold",
            family = "NotoSans") +
  # 僅103年有的類別（灰色附注）
  { if (nrow(db_only103) > 0)
      list(
        geom_point(data = db_only103, aes(x = pct103),
                   color = col_worker, size = 6),
        geom_text(data = db_only103,
                  aes(x = pct103, label = percent(pct103, 0.1)),
                  hjust = -0.35, color = col_worker, size = 5.5,
                  fontface = "bold", family = "NotoSans"),
        annotate("text", x = max(c(db_both$pct103, db_both$pct113), na.rm=TRUE)*0.6,
                 y = db_only103$category,
                 label = "（113年問卷無對應選項）",
                 hjust = 0, size = 4.5, color = "#aaaaaa", family = "NotoSans")
      ) } +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, max(c(db_both$pct103, db_both$pct113), na.rm=TRUE) * 1.45),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "「被人慫恿」：雇主最常歸因，移工自述卻非首位",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "<span style='color:", col_worker, "'>● 移工自述（103年，N≈1,958）</span>　",
      "<span style='color:", col_employer, "'>● 雇主認知（113年，N=146）</span>　",
      "（加權比例；分母為各自有效回答人數）"
    ),
    x        = "勾選比例",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "資料來源：勞動部移工關懷調查（103年家庭類）；移工管理及運用調查（113年家庭面）；以抽樣權重計算"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "NotoSans", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    plot.subtitle      = element_markdown(size = 13, color = "#555555",
                                          margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa", size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(angle = 0, size = 14),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

p_db
```

## 圖2：各視角完整原因排名（橫向長條）

```{r full-bar, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
d_full <- bind_rows(reasons103, reasons113) %>%
  mutate(
    perspective = factor(perspective,
                         levels = c("移工自述（103年）", "雇主認知（113年）")),
    label = str_replace_all(label, "\n", " ")
  )

# 按各視角內的比例排序（facet 內各自排序需用 tidytext::reorder_within）
library(tidytext)
d_full <- d_full %>%
  mutate(label = reorder_within(label, pct, perspective))

pal <- c("移工自述（103年）" = col_worker, "雇主認知（113年）" = col_employer)

p_full <- ggplot(d_full, aes(x = pct, y = label, fill = perspective)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, 0.1)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 5.5, fontface = "bold",
            family = "NotoSans", color = "gray30") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  facet_wrap(~perspective, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title   = "移工與雇主對「失聯原因」的完整排名",
    subtitle = "加權勾選比例；各自依比例由高至低排列",
    x       = "勾選比例",
    y       = NULL,
    caption = "資料來源：同上"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "NotoSans", base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 13, color = "#555555",
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa", size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(angle = 0, size = 14),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    strip.background   = element_blank()
  )

p_full
```

## 數字摘要

```{r table}
db %>%
  mutate(
    pct103 = percent(pct103, 0.1),
    pct113 = percent(pct113, 0.1)
  ) %>%
  select(category, pct103, pct113) %>%
  rename(原因類別 = category,
         `移工自述（103年）` = pct103,
         `雇主認知（113年）` = pct113) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "可對應類別的加權勾選比例比較")
```

## 結論

```{r conclusion, results="asis"}
pct_enc103 <- db %>% filter(str_detect(category, "慫恿")) %>% pull(pct103)
pct_enc113 <- db %>% filter(str_detect(category, "慫恿")) %>% pull(pct113)
pct_emp103 <- db %>% filter(str_detect(category, "雇主")) %>% pull(pct103)
pct_fee103 <- db %>% filter(str_detect(category, "仲介費")) %>% pull(pct103)
pct_fee113 <- db %>% filter(str_detect(category, "仲介費")) %>% pull(pct113)

cat(glue::glue(
  "- **受他人慫恿/轉介**：雇主勾選比例 **{percent(pct_enc113, 0.1)}**，移工僅 **{percent(pct_enc103, 0.1)}**，",
  "雇主對「被誘導」成因的歸因明顯高於移工自述，暗示雇主傾向將責任外化。\n",
  "- **與雇主/家人相處不融洽**：移工勾選比例高達 **{percent(pct_emp103, 0.1)}**，是移工自述最高原因；",
  "113年雇主問卷無對應選項，顯示此層面在雇主問卷設計上已被省略。\n",
  "- **仲介服務費太高**：移工 **{percent(pct_fee103, 0.1)}**，雇主 **{percent(pct_fee113, 0.1)}**，",
  "兩者皆低但存在——結合 103年仲介費負擔數據，費用壓力在長期中仍是結構性驅力。\n"
))
```
